text: Finishing the deck keeps the work private for another week.

why: A finished deck nobody has seen does not move a pilot.
wording: Show the diagnostic deck to two named leaders before it is finished

line: Would you take a call on Thursday about the pilot?
message:
I am working on a three week pilot that tells a leader where they stand on AI and what to do first.
Would you be willing to take a 30-minute call on Thursday to see if it fits your quarter?
It would help because you are deciding on AI this quarter and the pilot is built for that decision.
I can make this easy by sending the one-page scope first.
If it is not a fit, please say so.
why: Riley is deciding on AI this quarter and took a call with you in the spring.

stop: Stop after the easy-decline sentence. Do not explain the pilot again.
